highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: It adds variable and color font support, animated WebP encoding, new drawing and stream APIs, broader native assets, and substantial correctness fixes. This is a breaking release: review the migration notes before upgrading from v3.

breaking.title: Legacy SKPaint text, font and filtering APIs are compile errors
breaking.body: Previously obsolete SKPaint text/font members and paint-only drawing or shaping overloads are now errors. Move text state to `SKFont`, pass `SKTextAlign` explicitly, and replace `SKFilterQuality` use with `SKSamplingOptions` overloads.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs are removed from the reference surface
breaking.body: Legacy backend render-target constructors and run-buffer span methods are now compile errors; `SKPaintHinting` and `SKFilterQuality` are absent from the reference assembly. Use constructors without `sampleCount`, the `Glyphs` or `Positions` properties, `SKFontHinting`, and `SKSamplingOptions`.

breaking.title: A default SKFont now uses SKTypeface.Empty
breaking.body: `new SKFont()` and assigning a null typeface now produce an empty typeface, so text measures to zero and draws nothing. Construct with `SKTypeface.Default` or another explicit typeface, and use `Typeface.IsEmpty` to detect an unset font.

breaking.title: SKPaint and missing-family typeface null semantics change
breaking.body: `new SKPaint().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Default`, and `SKTypeface.FromFamilyName` returns the default rather than null for a missing Android family. Stop using those null checks; use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily` when a strict no-match result is required.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and checks its range
breaking.body: `SKStream.Move(long)` now throws `OverflowException` instead of truncating offsets outside the 32-bit native range. Validate the offset and call `Move(int)`.

breaking.title: Ganesh Vulkan now requires Vulkan 1.1
breaking.body: `GRContext.CreateVulkan` terminates the process for Vulkan 1.0 rather than returning null. Create the instance with Vulkan 1.1 or later and set `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` accordingly; Vulkan 1.0-only devices must use raster or another backend.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative removes legacy fields
breaking.body: The native Vulkan context drops `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. Delete those assignments, replace the extension and feature fields with `fVkExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures` or `fDeviceFeatures2`, and manage instance/device ownership separately.

breaking.title: Vulkan YCbCr conversion information changes type and layout
breaking.body: `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` now uses `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`, whose layout adds `Components`; the old-cased compatibility type no longer provides value equality. Update declarations and layout-dependent interop, populate `Components`, and replace equality operators with explicit field comparisons.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only
breaking.body: The protected setter for `IgnorePublicDispose` is removed. Custom subclasses must remove assignments and revise their disposal implementation so it no longer mutates this base property.

breaking.title: Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed
breaking.body: The Tizen arm and x86 packages are no longer produced after the Skia m147 update. Move Tizen deployments to the new `tizen-arm64` or `tizen-x64` runtime identifiers.

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets require .NET 8 or later
breaking.body: Native assets for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions are removed, and net6.0 or net7.0 WebAssembly projects now fail at build time. Upgrade WebAssembly applications to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: Assembly identity moves to v4
breaking.body: The SkiaSharp assembly version changes from 3.119.0.0 to 4.148.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any checks that pin the v3 assembly identity.

bullets.lead: Skia advances through m132 and m147 to m148
bullets.detail: The engine update brings HDR and wide-gamut improvements, codec and filter corrections, CICP color spaces, the RF16 and other HDR color types, plus upstream raster-pipeline, runtime-effect and malformed-region fixes.

bullets.lead: Bundled image and font libraries refreshed
bullets.detail: Updates libpng to 1.6.58, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, FreeType to 2.14.3, and libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, design positions, named instances and palette selection, with `HBColor` and conversion helpers representing HarfBuzz palette colors correctly.

bullets.lead: SKPathBuilder becomes the path mutation API
bullets.detail: The new builder wraps Skia's immutable-path model, while fill-path and path-measure operations gain builder overloads.

bullets.lead: Surface draws accept SKSamplingOptions
bullets.detail: New `SKSurface.Draw` and `SKCanvas.DrawSurface` overloads let callers control filtering and mipmapping when compositing surfaces.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding
bullets.detail: `SKWebpEncoder` writes single-frame or animated WebP content from frame sequences with per-frame durations.

bullets.lead: Streams expose backing SKData
bullets.detail: `SKStream.GetData()` returns ref-counted backing data when the stream can provide it cheaply, avoiding a copy for memory-backed streams.

bullets.lead: Missing document, GPU and mask-filter wrappers added
bullets.detail: Adds XPS document creation, per-image and per-surface GPU flushes, and shader-backed mask filters.

bullets.lead: Pixel spans honor row stride and coordinates
bullets.detail: `SKPixmap` and `SKBitmap` pixel spans now use `RowBytes`, and typed coordinate access uses the correct row axis for non-square images and subsets.

bullets.lead: Typeface and variable-font handling corrected
bullets.detail: Default typeface resolution no longer crashes on Android API 36, undersized variation spans report correctly, and `SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs` no longer recurses to a stack overflow.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization no longer dereferences a collected builder
bullets.detail: Disposal skips pending-builder flushing once finalization begins, preventing a crash when `SKPathBuilder` is collected first.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView survives tab and page navigation
bullets.detail: A reattached GL view starts with its existing dimensions instead of creating a zero-sized surface.

bullets.lead: WinUI projection loading restored for .NET 9
bullets.detail: The projection assembly is packaged under compatible .NET 9 and .NET 10 runtime folders so .NET 9 applications can load it at startup.

bullets.lead: NanoServer font initialization no longer crashes
bullets.detail: Windows NanoServer builds use an empty font manager when DirectWrite and GDI are unavailable, avoiding an access violation on first SkiaSharp use.

bullets.lead: Native compatibility checks wait for first interop use
bullets.detail: The compatibility gate moves from assembly initialization to `SkiaApi`, allowing applications to configure native-library resolution before the first P/Invoke while retaining version diagnostics.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets
bullets.detail: Adds `linux-bionic` x64 and arm64 packages and native libraries for the `tizen-x64` and `tizen-arm64` runtime identifiers.

bullets.lead: Apple library target frameworks realigned
bullets.detail: Library packages use the base 26.0 Apple target-platform versions, avoiding an unnecessary Xcode 26.2 requirement for consumers.

bullets.lead: WebAssembly support starts at .NET 8
bullets.detail: Packages retain Emscripten assets for .NET 8 and later and issue a clear build error for unsupported net6.0 and net7.0 applications.

bullets.lead: Linux compatibility baselines are explicit
bullets.detail: Official .NET cross-compilation images broaden the glibc baseline to 2.27 on arm64, x64 and x86 while preserving musl and Bionic packaging.

bullets.lead: libexpat receives security hardening
bullets.detail: The bundled XML parser advances to libexpat 2.8.1, including its upstream security-hardening changes.

contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and C# 13 support for legacy target frameworks
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone updates, variable fonts, default-typeface fixes, SKPath finalization, singleton lifecycle work, and v4 API migration
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Android SKGLView rendering after MAUI tab and page navigation

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Introduces the Skia m132-to-m147 engine update, SKPathBuilder, variable and color fonts, sampling-aware surface draws, managed typeface resolution, and Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. Removes 32-bit Tizen assets, makes `SKStream.Move(long)` checked and obsolete, refreshes libpng and libexpat, and fixes Android SKGLView navigation.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and `SKStream.GetData()`, fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and realigns Apple library target frameworks.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Requires .NET 8 for WebAssembly native assets and updates Vulkan YCbCr naming and layout. Adds `HBColor`, XPS creation, resource-specific GPU flushes and shader mask filters; fixes NanoServer font startup and refreshes libjpeg-turbo, FreeType and zlib.

v4.148.0-rc.1.2.summary: Promotes legacy SKPaint APIs to compile errors, makes `IgnorePublicDispose` read-only, and updates to Skia m148 with RF16, upstream correctness fixes, HarfBuzz 14.2.0 and hardened libexpat. Fixes pixel spans and .NET 9 WinUI loading, defers native compatibility checks until first interop use, and broadens Linux compatibility.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates HarfBuzzSharp from 8.3.1.5 to 14.2.0 with improved OpenType shaping, CFF2 subsetting and font-table handling. It also adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, the `HBColor` value type, and Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets.
